_about: DOC 236 RATIFICATION — WRITTEN (2026-09-09). All ten ADMT candidates carry 'CEO approved the prose (2026-09-09)' on their own ratify line. Their approved paragraphs are the sibling ratified-<id>.txt fixtures (script-extracted from doc 236's hard-wrapped blockquotes, joined with single spaces; markdown BOLD markers on the quoted FSOR clauses stripped and counted — words and quotation marks untouched). WRITTEN 2026-09-09 once authority_relevance_profiles carried product='admt' rows (10 live): this file is the single wiring spec the SQL generator read to INSERT the live authority_hooks rows AND the Deno test (tests/edge/run-admt-checker-v2/doc236-admt-ratified-prose.test.ts) reads, so the two can never drift. Every prep field is carried verbatim; the added fields are the live profile wiring, the NOT NULL paraphrases (authored from each candidate's own card/trigger text — never printed, literal_sentence_override bypasses every slot), the mechanically derived settledness, the live citation facts, the fixture md5, and the per-hook ratification decision.
_blocked_on_was: authority_relevance_profiles has ZERO rows for product='admt' as of 2026-09-09 (doc 239 §3.3 seeding SQL not yet run in Lovable). No authority_hooks row can be written until a profile exists to carry profile_id. Unblocking sequence is identical to tests/fixtures/doc234/hooks-prep.json's: run doc 239 §3.3 -> look up profile ids by (product, source_row_id) -> generate the INSERT from these fixtures (dollar-quoted override read from the file) as 'settled' -> re-query octet_length/md5 vs the fixture -> ONLY THEN the guarded UPDATE to 'ratified' with ledger_ref='doc236'.
_unblocked: authority_relevance_profiles now carries the product='admt' rows (read live 2026-09-09); every hook below links to its profile by (product, source_row_id) — the INSERT resolves profile_id by subselect AND asserts it equals the id recorded here.
_markup_decision_for_ceo: nine of the ten paragraphs bold the load-bearing quoted FSOR clause in the source markdown (`**"…"**`); a hook sentence is plain text, so the `**` markers were stripped (2 per paragraph; 6 for G2's three clauses; the vendor row's bold spans an unquoted phrase). If the CEO wants bold preserved for a markdown-capable renderer, regenerate the fixtures before any ADMT DB write.
_generate_time_blockers: every FSOR candidate's pinpoint is authorable from the row's own regulation_citation/page_ref (unlike the narrative enforcement rows) but none is authored here — generate.ts excludes a hook with no pinpoint BY NAME

hooks.finding_span: The regulations already include appropriate exceptions for security, fraud prevention, and safety
hooks.fact_pattern_paraphrase: an ADMT described as a security, fraud-prevention, or safety tool whose output also makes or feeds a significant decision, such as denying a transaction as fraudulent
hooks.finding_paraphrase: the regulations already include narrow, specific exceptions for security, fraud prevention, and safety, and a broader carve-out would be less effective at protecting consumer privacy, so the security-tool label does not by itself exempt a significant decision
